top_signals.title: JPMorgan Asset Sees Bitcoin Beating Stocks, But With a Catch
top_signals.summary: JPMorgan Asset Management has included Bitcoin in its long-term capital market assumptions for the first time, forecasting returns that could beat stocks, bonds and gold in a milestone for its Wall Street acceptance.

top_signals.title: Odd Lots: Are Financial Regulations Falling Apart?
top_signals.summary: From hot dog eating contests to political prop bets, CME CEO Terry Duffy tells Joe Weisenthal and Tracy Alloway why unchecked prediction markets risk violating federal manipulation standards. They spoke on the Odd Lots podcast, recorded live at Chicago's City Winery. Listen wherever you get your podcasts. (Source: Bloomberg)
